title: The allotment for the tribe of Benjamin
description: The whole assembly of Israel gathers at Shiloh and sets up the tent of meeting. Joshua sends three men from each of the seven remaining tribes to map out the land into seven parts, then casts lots before the Lord. The lot falls first on the tribe of Benjamin, which receives its territory between Judah and the house of Joseph. The account describes the boundaries and lists the cities—twelve and fourteen—that belonged to the tribe, including Jericho and Jebus (Jerusalem).
